title: fleet.drain input
description: One governed fleet-host drain. `host` names one declared fleet host; the daemon resolves the host's enabled registry nodes from its pinned snapshot, drains their drainable pods through its kube surface, or — when one of them holds the registry's authoritative state — returns the ordered authority-move plan without touching the cluster. Omit approvalId on the first call to request operator approval; retry with the exact approved host.

host.description: The declared fleet host to drain.

approvalId.description: The consumed operator approval binding this retry to the approved drain.
